scope.objective: Decide the project-safe path after exact-coordinate geometry found zero clean non-duplicate import-ready external FMO rows.
scope.decision_surface: homologous ligand-bound coordinates may be used for scalable review and stress diagnostics, but not for gold/countable import.

systems: RCSB mmCIF coordinate downloads parsed in temporary workspace
public_database_checks.local_similarity_method: Smith-Waterman style local protein alignment with match=2, mismatch=-1, linear gap=-2; values are review-tier estimates and not production scoring.
public_database_checks.coordinate_geometry_method: Temporary mmCIF atom_site parsing for FAD C4X/N5 proximity to nonbuffer substrate, product, O2, or analog ligands; no project geometry code, thresholds, production scoring, labels, registries, ontology files, imports, or model outputs were changed.

summary.bottom_line: Keep exact UniProt/PDB ligand-bearing coordinates as the gold/countable import rule. Use homologous ligand-bound coordinates only as silver/review evidence, active-site representation diagnostics, acquisition targeting, and Wave 1.1 flavin-redox stress panels.

policy_decision.gold_countable_import_rule: Exact UniProt/PDB ligand-bearing coordinates remain required for gold/countable label import. Exact means the source accession itself, or a defensible exact same-sequence/source construct explicitly accepted by review, not a homolog from a different UniProt accession.
minimum_gold_coordinate_content: source accession must have an exact experimental coordinate, not only an AlphaFold protein-only model
coordinate must contain flavin cofactor geometry, preferably with NAD(P)(H) or an accepted structural-state rationale for its absence
coordinate must contain candidate-specific substrate, product, or a chemically justified analog close enough to evaluate C4a/FAD oxygen-transfer geometry
duplicate/leakage gates and human import gates must pass
policy_decision.silver_review_only_rule: Homologous ligand-bound coordinates may only be used as silver/review-only evidence, active-site representation diagnostics, acquisition targeting, or learned-representation stress panels. They must be excluded from gold benchmark counts, primary supervised metrics, threshold tuning, production scoring, label imports, and registry/ontology edits.
policy_decision.bronze_source_only_rule: Source-clean biochemical evidence without exact ligand-bearing geometry remains bronze/source-only. Bronze leads can prioritize acquisition and review, but they cannot enter countable labels.
policy_decision.duplicate_hold_rule: Prior duplicate, leakage, or same-family holds remain controlling unless a new exact, non-duplicate, candidate-specific coordinate and terminal duplicate/leakage review explicitly reopens the decision.
policy_decision.wave_1_1_rule: Wave 1.1 and external flavin-redox panels may consume homologous coordinates only with tier metadata such as silver_review_only, homolog_not_gold, and excluded_from_gold_benchmark. Panel conclusions must not feed production scoring or corrupt the gold benchmark.

gold_labels.note: No external FMO row from this pass has exact source-accession ligand-bearing geometry plus non-duplicate import readiness.

The closest ligand-bearing coordinate is an ancestral mammalian FMO1 construct without exact Q01740 UniProt mapping and without candidate substrate/product ligand.
usable_for: class B FMO FAD/NADP pocket diagnostics

silver_review_only_evidence.why_silver_not_gold: Available ligand-bound homologs are broad BVMO relatives with partial local sequence coverage and no HAPMO-specific 4-hydroxyacetophenone/product coordinate.
usable_for: acquisition targeting for exact HAPMO coordinates

bronze_source_only_leads.reason: Source-clean CHMO/BVMO evidence remains non-countable until exact P12015 ligand-bearing geometry is found and import gates clear.
Source-clean HAPMO evidence remains non-countable until exact Q93TJ5 ligand-bearing geometry is found and import gates clear.
Source-clean human FMO1 evidence remains non-countable until exact Q01740 ligand-bearing geometry is found and import gates clear.

hard_negative_controls.panel_role: Prevent FAD/NAD(P)H binding from being treated as sufficient FMO evidence.
Separate O2 terminal-acceptor or peroxide-producing flavoproteins from substrate oxygen insertion.
Protect against overabsorbing flavin plus Fe-S electron relay proteins into FMO.
Hard reject non-heme di-iron NO reduction despite flavin involvement.
Hard reject radical dehydration and Fe-S radical chemistry as FMO.
Prevent covalent FAD-substrate sulfur-oxygen chemistry from being treated as C4a-peroxy monooxygenation.
Route heme-centered oxygen activation away from FMO even when reaction names include oxygenase or monooxygenase.
Keep non-flavin oxygen activation and ATP/luciferyl-adenylate oxygenations out of FMO.
